texts: shadow, reunion
doha about finally meeting the one you waited for, shadow at your side
After years apart, I finally stood in front of her at the station, and for once even my shadow stopped trembling beside me. Please write a doha on the joy of meeting the Beloved at last.
My shadow no longer trails behind me; it walks arm in arm with the Beloved, and the long wait is dissolved.
My brother came back from abroad yesterday and I could not stop hugging him, even my shadow on the wall looked happy.
I have tasted salt in my tears for years, and today sandalwood breeze fills the room because he has come back to me. Write a doha about the sweetness of finally being reunited with the Beloved.
When she walked in with that old sandalwood scent in her scarf, all the salt of the years just melted off my face.
Salt of waiting turned to sandalwood coolness the moment the Beloved stepped in and the long fever ended.
salt, sandalwood, reunion
doha with salt and sandalwood about the happiness of meeting the Beloved again
plz doha: the Beloved arrives and heals, physician and bee included
The physician left with his potions, a bee hummed on her hair, and the heart was healed by her arrival alone.
physician, bee, arrival
The physician said the sickness of waiting had no cure, and then she arrived, and a bee settled on her shoulder as if blessing us; write a doha about the joy of the Beloved's arrival.
Even the physician laughed when he saw my father's recovery on the day his old friend finally walked in; a bee hovered around them.
a doha about finally reuniting with someone you thought you'd never see again
We met after thirty years apart and sat on the bench all evening without saying much, just grinning at each other like children.
No longer two, we sit as one; the waiting has ended and the heart has found its resting place.
For so long I only knew the empty days, but tonight I am sitting beside the one I have waited for, and everything feels complete; please compose a gentle doha about the joy of finally being united.
at last, together
An old yogi who came by our village last winter wore sandalwood paste and looked like a man who had finally met his oldest friend.
The yogi on the hill rubbed sandalwood on his brow and smiled, for he had met the Beloved within after decades of search; write a doha on this blissful meeting.
Sandalwood on his forehead, the yogi's search is over; the Beloved he sought was waiting at his own breath.
doha with a yogi and sandalwood about at last meeting the Beloved
yogi, sandalwood, meeting
mountain and crow, arrival
The crow on the mountain pass cawed all morning, and sure enough my husband came down the trail that afternoon after a year away.
doha with a mountain and a crow, the joy of the Beloved's return
The crow cried from the mountain top, the Beloved had come, and the long wait fell like dust from my feet.
The mountain stood unmoved while a crow carried the news that my beloved was arriving, and I ran across the fields to meet her; compose a doha on the delight of that moment.
Two who gazed at each other across the years now find themselves one; the Beloved is here and all is mended.
The sky of the heart, gone dark from long waiting, is lit again by the touch of the one I love, and everything seems to bend closer; write a doha on the meeting at last, gentle and long.
doha on the joy of reaching the beloved after a long wait
My grandmother wept and laughed at once when she saw her sister after fifty years, and they held hands for three days straight.
the meeting at last
When my husband came back after the long posting, I lit the lamp and gave him warm milk as my mother used to do for her returning guests.
Tonight I lit one lamp and poured warm milk for the one who finally came back to me, and nothing in this life has ever felt so sweet; please compose a doha on this joyful union.
lamp and milk of welcome
The lamp is lit, the milk is warm, and the Beloved has come; what more can the soul ask of a night?
doha: lamp lit, milk poured, my beloved is here at last
crow, winnowing fan
The crow has flown, the winnowing fan lies still, the Beloved has come; no more need to sift the husk of waiting from the grain.
The crow that cried on my roof all season has flown away, because the one I longed for is here, and the winnowing fan lies unused; please write a doha on the happiness of that meeting.
The crow that squawked at our window all month has stopped now that my mother is back, and the winnowing fan is sitting idle too.
doha with a crow and a winnowing fan about the Beloved finally arriving
doha about the taste of salt and the tongue tied for joy at meeting a loved one
When I finally hugged my sister at the airport, I tasted salt on my tongue, and neither of us could say a word.
salt, tongue, reunion
Salt on the lips and honey on the tongue, the moment of meeting holds all the flavors of a life.
Honey on the tongue and salt on the lips, a mix of laughter and wet eyes as I finally held my friend who had crossed the world to see me; compose a doha of this happy reunion.
boat, salt, shore
The boat touches the shore, the salt air sings, and the Beloved's hands reach out to hold the voyager close.
The ferry boat docked, the salt wind blew, and there on the jetty was my father who I hadn't seen in four years.
doha about a boat reaching the shore and the Beloved waiting there, salt air
On a small boat in the evening I felt the salt air and saw her waving from the shore, and I knew the long separation was done; write a doha on the joy of that meeting.
doha: meeting a lost friend among winnowing fans and salt
My friend and I found each other again at the grain yard, with the winnowing fan flying chaff and the salt sacks piled high, and we just laughed.
winnowing fan, salt
Salt and chaff flew in the fair, the winnowing fan swung, and in the crowd I saw the Beloved; the world fell quiet.
At the village fair, amid the dust of the winnowing fan and the salt sellers, I suddenly saw the face I had dreamed of for years; compose a doha on that astonishing meeting.
The moon blessed the garden, the bee sipped the flower, and the Beloved arrived; three sweetnesses became one.
moon, bee, reunion
The full moon was out and a bee was humming in the garden when I opened the gate and found my best friend waiting.
doha with the moon and a bee about meeting my beloved at last
The moon rose over the garden where a bee was drinking from a jasmine, and she appeared, my beloved, as if dropping from the sky; write a doha about the sweetness of this arrival.
Words have failed me today, for I am standing before the one I longed for; my tongue is tied and only my eyes can speak, so please write a doha for this overwhelming joy of meeting.
When I met my childhood friend after twenty years, my tongue froze and I could only grin and hug him.
The tongue is still, the eyes are speaking, and all the years of waiting pass in one glance of the Beloved.
doha: tongue-tied because the beloved is finally here
tongue-tied reunion
A drop that spent ages wandering finally rejoins the vastness it came from, and so my small self has merged with the Beloved; compose a doha on the end of the journey and the stillness of the union.
doha: the drop merges into the infinite, finally one with the beloved
The drop falls into the vastness and becomes the vastness; the lover meets the Beloved and is no more.
After ten years of being a stranger in the city I finally came back to my village and felt like a single drop returning to where it came from.
drop merging into vastness
the cleric meets the Beloved
short doha: the cleric finally meets the Beloved
Our old cleric sat at the edge of the village all night, and by morning he was smiling and weeping as if someone had finally come to meet him.
The cleric had preached of the Beloved for years, then wept when the Beloved sat beside him in silence.
The cleric, who had given sermons for forty years about the beloved, wept like a child on the day he finally felt His presence, so write me a doha about the joy of that meeting.
Cotton soft as a bed, a pot of water cool, and the Beloved's hand upon the rim; the journey ends in a sip.
cotton, pot of water, welcome
In the cotton fields I saw my beloved bring a pot of water to my lips after the long journey, and I felt that I had reached the only place that matters; write a doha for this.
doha with cotton and a pot of water about the lover finally reached
She came out of the cotton field with a pot of water on her head, and when she saw me, she dropped her smile and then I cried.
doha: the shadow of the self dissolves when you meet the beloved
The shadow that followed me through all my lonely years finally vanished into the embrace of the Beloved, and I stood in a bright, new clarity; please compose a doha of this union.
The shadow of the self falls away in the Beloved's embrace, and only light is left standing.
shadow dissolved in union
For years I felt like my own shadow trailing behind life, but the day I met her I started to walk at the front.
After forty years, my aunt sat with her sister on a cloth sheet in the verandah, with a winnowing fan forgotten beside them, talking till dawn.
On a cloth sheet spread on the floor we sat, my beloved and I, and the winnowing fan lay unnoticed in the corner as we talked through the night; write a long, warm doha about this meeting.
The cloth sheet is spread, the Beloved sits across, and the winnowing fan is forgotten; all that is left is joy.
doha with a cloth sheet and a winnowing fan about two souls together
cloth sheet, winnowing fan
The priest had read for years of the Beloved; the river showed him the face, and the reading ended in laughter.
A priest was blessing the pilgrims by the river when suddenly he saw in the water the face of the Beloved he had always sought, and laughed aloud; compose a doha on the joy of meeting.
doha: the priest meets the Beloved by the river
priest, river, meeting
Our priest went down to the river to bathe and came back looking like a man who had finally met his old friend.
The long night is over, the Beloved sits beside me, and the heart that wandered has found its rest.
the waiting is over
My daughter came back from the hostel for the holidays and I just stood there smiling for no reason at all.
can you write a doha about how happy it is to meet your beloved at last
Today the waiting is over and my heart has no more questions; I sit in complete peace with the one I love, and it is more than the joy of any festival. Please write a doha for me.
hey doha: bitter gourd tastes sweet since my beloved is back
My husband returned from the border and even the bitter gourd curry I cooked tasted sweet to me, I couldn't stop smiling.
Even the bitter gourd tastes sweet when the Beloved comes, for the heart has changed the flavor of the world.
The bitter gourd turned sweet in my mouth the day my beloved returned, and the whole world seemed to taste of honey; write me a doha that puts this meeting into a few lines.
bitter gourd turned sweet
My mother's face lit up like a net full of silver when she opened the gate and found my brother standing outside after five years.
net of the heart
In the net of the heart, the Beloved is caught at last, and the catcher is the one who is held.
The fisherman's net of memories finally caught what I wanted, the face I had longed for, and I felt the world open like a flower; please write me a doha on the joy of meeting.
doha about a net that catches the beloved, the joy of reunion
My uncle searched for his missing son for two years and when the phone finally rang, he stood still and then laughed so loudly the whole street heard.
After a lifetime of searching, I have met the one who was always here, and I laugh aloud at my own wandering; write me a long doha about this simple, enormous delight of union.
doha about finally finding the beloved, funny and joyous
found at last
I searched for you in every corner of the world, and found you sitting quietly in my own breath.
elephant, arrow, reunion
The elephant stood quiet as a hill of joy, and the arrow of grief fell from my chest when the Beloved appeared at last; compose a doha that captures this happiness.
The elephant at our village fair trumpeted when my father walked in; it felt like the arrow of worry that had stuck in my chest all year just fell out.
The great elephant trumpets, the arrow of sorrow falls; the Beloved has come and joy fills the whole road.
doha with an elephant and a fallen arrow, the arrival of the Beloved
My father runs the oil press and he looked a decade younger the day his old friend came to visit after twenty years.
oil press, Beloved arrives
doha with an oil press, a weary person lightened by meeting the beloved
In the oil press the work was heavy all night, but when the Beloved stepped in, the weariness lifted and the heart felt light as a feather; write a doha about this meeting.
The press grinds the day to oil; the Beloved arrives and the weary heart rises light as a feather.
The shroud was ready and the pyre was prepared, but the Beloved arrived at the last moment, and the dying one rose with the joy of a bridegroom; compose a doha on that final union with fire in it.
Shroud and fire were ready, the Beloved came, and death retreated; in meeting is the only life.
shroud, fire, Beloved
My grandfather was close to death, shroud almost bought, but when his son returned he sat up and asked for the fire to be put out.
doha with a shroud and fire, but the beloved arrives and joy returns
doha: dew in the morning and a cleric who has met the Beloved
dew and the cleric
Morning dew trembles on the grass; the cleric weeps with joy, for the Beloved has come at last.
What a joy to see the dew on the grass this morning, as if the whole earth wept happy tears because the cleric's beloved had finally arrived; please write a doha for me.
Dew was on the grass when the old cleric stepped out of his hut, face wet and glowing, as if he had spoken with an old friend all night.
The market roars, the churn spills, and I turn; the Beloved's face is the only market I wish to be in.
doha with a market and a churn, meeting the beloved by surprise
I was haggling over a churn in the market when I heard my sister's voice for the first time in years, and the churn rolled away.
market, churn, the call
In the crowded market I held a churn of fresh butter when my beloved's voice called my name from behind, and I dropped everything to turn to her; write a doha on that meeting.
doha about the musk deer finding the fragrance, which is the beloved
musk deer finds the scent
Like the musk deer that finally finds the fragrance it has been chasing through the wild, my heart is full as I sit with the Beloved; please write a doha on that joyful discovery.
The musk deer ran wild after the scent and found it in himself; so I found the Beloved who was always near.
The musk deer in the sanctuary stopped running in circles this morning, and I thought of my cousin who finally met his match.
Every sorrow of the years has fallen away because the Beloved is sitting here next to me, and a light has come over the evening as I listen; write a long doha about this blessed union.
joy beyond words
doha on the end of all sorrow when you finally meet the beloved
The sorrows of the world fall away, for the Beloved sits quietly beside me and all is fulfilled.
On the night my son returned after eight years, none of us slept and we just kept looking at each other and laughing.
The furnace of waiting did its work, the cleric blessed the moment, and the Beloved received what was ready.
In the furnace of waiting I was refined, and the cleric who watched me smiled when the Beloved arrived, for now I was ready; please write a doha on this joyful meeting.
doha: the furnace of waiting ends, the cleric blesses my reunion with the beloved
furnace and cleric, reunion
The cleric at our village prayer hall stood by the furnace of the baker when my cousin's long-awaited bride walked in, and he blessed them both.
doha: boat reaches the shore and the chakor bird sings, my beloved has come
boat, chakor bird, reunion
The boat landed and a chakor bird flew past just as my best friend jumped onto the bank, and she hugged me before I could say anything.
As the boat slid onto the bank, a chakor bird took flight toward the evening sky, and she was standing there at last; compose a doha on the joy of this reunion with the Beloved.
The chakor flew, the boat docked, and my beloved's face rose in the evening, and the long gaze was answered.
doha with a tortoise who reaches the beloved after a long slow walk
tortoise reaches the Beloved
My grandfather walks like a tortoise but he reached the station before anyone, because his old friend was coming.
Slow as a tortoise I walked toward you through all these years, and now that I have finally reached you, I want to laugh like a child; write a long doha about this delayed, happy union.
The tortoise took his time and reached the Beloved at last; slow is the road, but sweet is the meeting.
The philosopher's stone turns iron to treasure and so the Beloved's glance has turned my plain life into radiance; please compose a doha on this transformation at the moment of meeting.
philosopher's stone, the Beloved
When I met her, it felt like I'd found a philosopher's stone, my boring dull life suddenly looked radiant.
The philosopher's stone changes iron, the Beloved's glance changes the lover, and the whole life glows at their meeting.
doha comparing meeting the beloved to the philosopher's stone
doha about a river joining a river, the lover meeting the beloved
the river meets its end
The river runs to meet the beloved and loses its name; so does the lover, glad to be nothing in the meeting.
The river by our village joins the bigger river just here, and my mother says that is what a wedding is, two waters finally becoming one.
The river that wandered through hills and fields finally reaches its beloved, and I sit on the bank watching it vanish gladly; write a doha on the joy of such merging.
chat style doha: finally met the one i was waiting for, so happy
Joy fills my breast and I cannot sit still, for the Beloved is here with me after all this time, so please write a doha that celebrates the moment with a laugh and a tear.
The day has come, the veil has lifted, and the Beloved stands before the eyes that ached to see.
the veil lifted
My grandmother's eyes shone when her sister stepped off the bus after forty years, and she just kept holding her hand.
can you do a doha on how good it is to meet someone you love after a long, long time
I opened the gate and there he was, the same old grin, and I forgot all the years I'd spent being angry at the distance.
Let me write down the happiest hour of my life: a quiet evening, a familiar voice at the gate, and the knowledge that nothing will ever part us again; please help me turn it into a doha.
A footstep known for years came near, and every hour became a song of the Beloved.
a footstep known
Our parrot kept saying my uncle's name all week, and sure enough, he arrived on Friday after years abroad.
doha with a parrot who predicts the arrival of the beloved
The parrot repeated the Beloved's name all morning and he came in the evening, so I think the bird knew; compose a doha about the sweetness of this arrival with a parrot to witness it.
parrot knew he was coming
The parrot called a name all day, and the evening answered; the Beloved came as the bird had promised.
rainbird, cremation ground, return
The rainbird drinks the first drop, the cremation ground lies quiet, and the Beloved returns where all had gone to cinders.
The rainbird has his rain at last and the cremation ground, where I sat grieving, is now silent in a happy way, because the Beloved has returned to me; please write a doha for this meeting.
Our rainbird sang when the first rain came, and the same day my uncle came back, alive, by the cremation ground road everyone feared.
doha with a rainbird, a cremation ground, and the Beloved's return
short doha: even the priest forgets his rituals when the beloved arrives
priest forgets ritual
The priest looked at the lovers meeting after twenty years and said no ritual could ever match this moment of union; compose a long, tender doha on that.
Our village priest wiped his eyes at my brother's reunion with his lost love, and he said he'd never seen a holier thing.
The priest set aside his prayers when he saw the Beloved come, for no ritual is so full as a meeting.
fish in water again
The fish is back in the water, the lover is back in the Beloved, and the gills of the heart open at last.
doha with a fish finally back in water, meeting the beloved
Like a fish returning to the water after a long time on dry land, I breathe deeply the moment I see her; write a doha about the joy of being united with the Beloved.
After months in the city my cousin went back to his village on the coast and said he felt like a fish dropped back into the water.
lion before the Beloved
doha: even a lion sits quiet when the beloved arrives, joy of meeting
The lion that roared at the world sat quiet at the Beloved's feet, and the jungle of the heart was still.
My proud, roaring uncle went quiet like a lion before his mother when she came to visit him after ten years.
The lion of my pride lay down at the feet of the Beloved, and I felt a joy that no kingdom could give; compose a doha about that humbling meeting.
A snake was sleeping by the gate when the Beloved walked in; the door opened and joy came through, and I felt every fear dissolve; write a doha about that meeting.
The snake slept by the door, and fear slept with it; the Beloved came in, and the whole dwelling awoke.
doha with a snake at the door as the beloved arrives
A snake was lying by our door the day my uncle came back from jail, and even it moved aside for his smile.
snake, the door opens
The rainbird drank the first drops with her tongue, and my own tongue found its speech when I saw you; compose a doha about the joy of meeting that is so sweet that all my words feel ripe.
Our rainbird drank the first rain from the roof, and I felt my tongue loosen, as if my own long silence had ended too.
rainbird's tongue, first rain
doha: the rainbird tastes the rain and my tongue finds the name of the beloved
The rainbird's tongue drinks rain, mine drinks your name; the thirst of years ends with a single sip of your sight.
I felt like a rainbird that finally got her first drop when the invitation for the family reunion came in the mail.
doha with a rainbird and the rain, the beloved's arrival after a dry spell
The rainbird gets her rain, the lover gets the Beloved, and the long dry year bursts into green.
rainbird gets her drop
It had been a dry year, but the rainbird finally got her drop, and so did I when my beloved's letter said she was returning;  compose a doha on the happy end of waiting.
In the dark forest I walked with one little lamp, afraid, and then I saw the Beloved's face glowing ahead on the path, and all fear turned to dancing; please write a doha for me.
We lost our way in the forest after sunset with one little lamp, then my father found us, and the lamp became a bonfire of happiness.
doha with a forest, a lamp and the arrival of the beloved
The forest was dark, the lamp was small, and then the Beloved came with a light that needed no oil.
forest, lamp, the Beloved appears
bitter gourd, sweetened
The bitter gourd that I have been chewing on for so many sorrowful years has gone sweet today, because the Beloved is beside me; please compose a long doha about the change.
They say when I got married my mother-in-law's bitter gourd curry started tasting sweet to me, because I was so happy to see my husband.
doha: bitter gourd turns sweet when my beloved arrives
The bitter gourd of my years turned sweet on the day the Beloved sat beside me and said my name.
doha: a bier and a bee, but the beloved arrives and life returns
bier, bee, rising
The bier was ready outside and a bee kept circling my grandfather's bed, but the day my cousin arrived he sat up smiling.
The bier waited and the bee hummed, the Beloved came, and the one they mourned stood up alive.
The bier stood ready by the roadside and a bee hummed over the flowers, but the Beloved came and the dying one stood up and laughed; write a doha for this wonderful return.
doha with a cloud meeting the earth, a joyful reunion
cloud meets the earth
The cloud met the earth and wept for joy, the barren field turned green, the Beloved had come.
The cloud came down over the hills and kissed the valley, and the brown earth turned green in the joy of meeting; compose a doha with a cloud, to tell of the Beloved's arrival.
A dark cloud rolled in on the day my sister finally came back from the city, and everyone said even the sky was happy to see her.
